title: Plunger bends, but it bends, too much.
text: Plunger bends, but it bends, too much.. The bending is great, but it's like trying to scrub under the rim with a wet noodle.  I turned it different angles and it still wouldn't stay stiff enough to scrub.  The no drip part of the brush and container is great.  I just can't scrub my toilet like I would like.

product_metadata.title: Unger No-Drip Toilet Brush Set,5.35 x 17.7 x 4.8 inches
features: Flexible neck can stay firm for extra scrubbing power or flexes to get into hard-to-reach places
Open holder allows bristles to air dry
Handle is designed for a secure, comfortable grip
Caddy is designed to discretely hide the toilet brush from view when not in use
description: No more dripping with this toilet brush and portable caddy from Unger. The lightweight caddy is designed to catch any drips after cleaning toilet, before placing it back on the floor. The handle has a flexible neck that bends to clean under the rim and other hard-to-reach places or stays firm to scrub tough stains. Caddy is designed to discretely hide the toilet brush from view when not in use.
